question: A flexible wire loop in the shape of a square of side $10 \text{ cm}$ lies in a uniform magnetic field $B = 1.0 \text{ T}$ perpendicular to the plane of the loop. If the loop is deformed into a circular shape of the same perimeter in $0.1 \text{ s}$, find the average induced EMF.
